what: Per-case CI seconds of the saved-source tier from the per-case progress lines of three runs, the source of SOURCE_CI_SECONDS in tools/run_fast_tests_v2.py (the mean, rounded, for cases over 30 s). Each case ran on a different runner in each run. Two later runs of the mean-weighted split are recorded under out_of_sample_runs and are not in the mean. Two further runs (36504569527, 36505271124) are added to out_of_sample_runs with their job seconds, checkout seconds and margin to the 35-minute cap; runner_factors.out_of_sample_instances measures their six shard instances against the same reference; unweighted_cases records the one case the weights do not cover.

36505271124.note: same weights; all 17 checks green; shard jobs 34m26s / 21m36s / 33m03s - shard 0 ended 34 s before the 35-minute job cap on a runner at factor 1.29 (checkout 26 s, tests 2,034 s), the smallest margin of any passing shard in the eight three-shard runs on this branch (the previous smallest was 46 s, shard 2 of run 36485982390)

runner_factors.method: each case's reference is the geometric mean of its seconds over runs 36485856267, 36485982390, 36492046303 and 36492131767 (the four runs that reached every case); a shard instance's factor is the median over its cases with a reference of at least 60 s of seconds / reference
runner_factors.out_of_sample_note: the six shard instances of runs 36504569527 and 36505271124, measured against the same four-run reference; they range 0.621 to 1.291, so across all eighteen instances the factor runs 0.621 to 1.311, a spread of 2.1; min/max/spread above describe the first twelve only

tests.vnext.test_d03_current_source_repl.note: added by the base at 76ebe42e after the weights were set; the split places it at the default 30 s, about 50 s below what it takes. Not re-weighted: the error is small next to the runner-speed swing on the same cases (shard 0's 43 cases summed 3,206 s in one of these runs and 4,050 s in the other), and a new table would need its own CI round; the remedy for the swing is the fourth shard (0005).
